caption: The drawing features a decorative pattern with a pink background divided into vertical sections by white ornate, floral borders. Within each section are alternating motifs of flowers and pastoral scenes. In the left section, the upper motif depicts a large flower with light pink petals, a dark center, and green leaves. Below it, there is a scene of a church or cottage with a spire, surrounded by trees in shades of green, and other foliage, all set on a small patch of land. In the right section, the upper motif depicts a windmill, a house, and a grazing sheep, with green trees and bushes, all set on a green and brown platform of land. Below this, there is another large flower with white and pink petals, a dark center, and green leaves. Each scene or floral motif is separated vertically by stylized white floral designs. The composition uses a color palette mainly of pink, green, white, and black. The overall layout is rectangular, with the artwork placed on a wider beige background. At the bottom right corner, the name "S. Liswood" appears in small text.
